name: Further Corruption
label: Quest
description: Further Corruption: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A second encampment of satyrs threatens the land of Felwood towards the north, led by the cruel Xavaric. The vile betrayers and tricksters feed upon the corruption of the native creatures of Felwood.
Xavathras and his minions were only part of a larger plan -- to cultivate a corrupted moonwell, and then provide the spoils to Xavaric.
Now that Xavathras is out of the way, finish this task, friend. Head to the north and defeat Xavaric.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Please, put and end to the suffering of Felwood's creatures.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you for all you have done, friend. May Elune protect you and guide you on the path ahead.
